opening: I am writing to apply for the Forward Deployed Engineer role at STRATOS Technologies. That is the work I have spent the last three years doing, and the combination you describe of scalable AI workflows and intricate data integration is the exact pairing my day already consists of: LLM orchestration on one side, connecting messy external systems on the other.
role_specific: My daily engineering workflow revolves around the exact requirements outlined in your role: I utilize prompt chaining, RAG architectures, and advanced workflow orchestration tools (such as n8n) to connect external APIs with foundational models like OpenAI and Anthropic's Claude, working in Python, SQL and TypeScript. Turning a business requirement into a maintainable pipeline is the core of what I did for UltraStrategy and Get2Germany, and the CRM integration work at FlowSpace is directly comparable to the ERP and CRM exposure you list as preferred. I should be straightforward about one gap: I have not worked with PySpark or Palantir AIP specifically, and my distributed-processing experience is with the pipelines I have built rather than with Spark at scale. I pick up new systems quickly, which is most of what my last three years have consisted of, and I would rather say that plainly than let it surface in a first call.
closing: I would be glad to talk through a client implementation you have run recently and how I would have approached the integration.
